🔖 Learning

Label

In simple words

The right answer attached to a training example, such as “cat” on a photo of a cat.

The correct answer that goes with an example in supervised learning: the category of a photo, whether an email is spam, the price of a house. A model learns by comparing its guesses with the labels, so wrong labels teach it wrong answers. Labels are often added by people, one example at a time.

Example. To teach a model to spot healthy and sick leaves, each photo is labelled “healthy” or “sick”, ideally by someone who knows plants.

Related words

  • Supervised learningLearning from examples that come with the right answers (labels).
  • DatasetA large, organised collection of examples used to train or test an AI model.
  • Data cleaningFinding and fixing mistakes in data, such as missing, wrong, repeated or impossible values, before a model learns from it.
